text: Dan Ives: China Tariff Truce Revitalizes Bull Case for Apple as Half of User Base Approaches Upgrade Cycle
sentiment_reasoning: The article suggests that the U.S.-China tariff truce provides a significant opportunity for Apple, as it approaches a major iPhone upgrade cycle where half of its user base is expected to purchase new devices. Analyst Dan Ives maintains a positive outlook on Apple's stock, with a price target of $270 per share, indicating an upside of over 30%.
